gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mende-ki: Strokes that never thin out at the curves give College a stout, authoritative look. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui sits beside it as a plain sans with light showing through every bowl, which makes the two feel like a shout and a easy reply.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Chunky and confident, College draws its diagonals as heavy as its stems. Noto Sans Meroitic follows with open, approachable letters that fill the line like capitals, so a long passage would read steadily and without fuss.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-modi: Authoritative, with no thick-thin shifts anywhere in College. Noto Sans Modi keeps daylight inside each curve and holds its lowercase close to cap height, so a long passage would run smooth and modern.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono brings generously spaced letters and a sturdy, tall lowercase. Beside it, College draws true monoline strokes with big counters, and a sizing hint would be to let the heading take the larger size.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-mro: Dense, blunt and tall in the middle, College leaves no stroke thicker than another from stem to terminal. And Noto Sans Mro, a sans-serif with large entrances into each letter, would carry a long passage with a modern, businesslike ease.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-multani: Dynamic, with strokes that look drawn by a compass pencil, College fills its counters wide and tall. Noto Sans Multani reads a plain sans way, easygoing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Heavy, even and unflickering, College carries no thick-thin contrast to catch the eye, and its counters sit wide open. Noto Sans Myanmar suits a bit smaller sizing.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-nabataea: Stout and sure of itself, College frames every counter with strokes of the same width. And Noto Sans Nabataean, a sans-serif with lowercase almost cap-tall, would read over a long stretch with a crisp, contemporary stride.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-nag-mund: Noto Sans Nag Mundari reads as a plain sans with half-unwrapped curves and a lowercase that rivals its capitals. But College answers with horizontals exactly as heavy as its verticals, a firmer and more commanding presence.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans-nandinag: Noto Sans Nandinagari reads easily, with a big lowercase, short ascenders and openings that stay generous at every weight. College does the loud work with technical-pen steadiness; the body does the quiet talking.
